sections.advice: High point near Bracknell → Food stop in Wivelsfield Green rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.

sections.to: Near Cranbrook, on the way back

sections.from: Near Cranbrook, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Great Dunmow → Scenic stretch near Old Harlow can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Scenic stretch near Old Harlow → Near Brent is the reward section in London motorcycle escapes. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.narrative: 55 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 41 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-berg-en-dal-aqueduct-marienboom-m.story: 199 km from Hengstdal to Hengstdal, about 3 h 26 of riding. On the way it passes Till, Xanten-CUT, Moers-Asberg and back through Xanten-CUT. jp-zao-echo-line.story: Sustained elevation change, linked bends and open summit views. It also links naturally to Zao Quasi-National Park.
